geometry.locator: arXiv:2401.07684, 'positioned at 17.1 m from the reactor core center'
geometry.note: CONUS's own paper (arXiv:2401.07684) states the detector sat 17.1 m from the reactor core center at Brokdorf, inside the reactor building itself (not a separate structure). No fetched source gives the azimuth of that 17.1 m offset from the core, so this point is the OSM 'Reaktorgebäude' building's own centroid (geometry:brokdorf-core), used directly as the detector's position; accuracy_m is widened to 20 m to cover the unresolved 17.1 m offset plus the building footprint's own ~15 m accuracy.

summary.plain: The approximate position of the CONUS coherent-neutrino-scattering detector, which sat inside the Brokdorf reactor building 17.1 m from the reactor core, 2018-2023.
